title: Norwegian Fish Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Norway, made with fresh fish, vegetables, and a hint of cream.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until softened.
Add sliced carrots and potatoes, cook for 5 minutes.
Add fish fillets, cook for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in fish stock, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Stir in light cream, cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
